finalText:
I didn't make the change the Stop check asked for.

**Why I left it:** The check says all 278 elements on the board, including the section frames, are new and should be marked as made by AI. That isn't true. I compared the board file with the last saved version in git. Every one of those elements was already there, and each is still credited to the person who made it (Tereza, Jonas, Ivana, Marek, Petra). Relabeling them as AI would put the wrong author on people's work. It would also mean editing the two locked stickies and the pricing vote, which belong to people and must not be changed. The check seems to have flagged the whole board by mistake, not anything this delete added.

**What actually changed on the board:**
- The 22 unlocked stickies in the Done section are gone. The two locked ones, "fixed the double sign-in" and "renamed Publish button", are still there.
- Three arrows started on stickies I deleted ("fixed the double sign-in (+1 Petra)" and "renamed Publish button (+1 Ivana)"). The delete tool kept those arrows and pinned their start to the spot where the sticky was. Their other ends still point to their stickies in other sections. You may want to delete or reconnect them.
- Nothing else changed.

If the check keeps blocking, the problem is in the check itself and someone should look at it. Fixing it by relabeling the board would put the wrong author on people's work.
